goal: Refactor the model detail Settings tab into a tab-based UI (General / Routing / Advanced) with the monolithic 603-line hook split into three focused sub-hooks plus a thin composer.
architectureSummary: Three extracted hooks (useModelConfigForm, useModelAliases, useModelConfigSave) compose into a slim useModelConfigPage controller. The rewritten ModelConfigForm renders a shadcn Tabs shell hosting three leaf tab components, with a sticky footer reflecting combined dirty state from the form and aliases hooks.
techStack: shadcn/ui (Tabs, CollapsibleSection, Switch, Select, Card, Button, Input, Label)
globalConstraints: No backend, API, schema, or routing-structure changes — pure apps/web refactor.
Save behavior must match current behavior exactly: updateModel(modelName, routeUpdate, undefined, config) first, then updateModelAliases if aliases loaded, with the same partial-failure toasts.
ModelConfigFormData loses aliasesLoaded, aliasesLoading, aliasesLoadError — these move into useModelAliases return shape.
All hint text in English; remove the existing hard-coded Portuguese hint on Owned By.
Feature isolation: new files live under apps/web/src/features/models/; import only from @/shared/* and sibling feature files.
No new top-level directories; respect apps/web/AGENTS.md anti-patterns.
shadcn primitives reused: Tabs, CollapsibleSection (@/shared/components/ui/collapsible-section), Card, Switch, Select, Input, Label, Button.
Dirty indicator and Save enablement reflect formIsDirty || aliasesIsDirty.
Reasoning sub-section collapses by default; collapsing never clears values.

fileStructure.notes: Slimmed ModelConfigFormData type, modelToFormData, buildConfigFromFormData, form state, dirty tracking, extra-param handlers. NEW file.
Aliases query + mutation state, normalizeAliases, getAliasValidationError, dirty tracking, reset-on-model. NEW file.
updateModel mutation + updateModelAliases orchestration with partial-failure toasts. NEW file.
General tab leaf component + extracted ReasoningSection using CollapsibleSection. NEW file.
Routing tab wrapping existing ModelAliasesEditor. NEW file.
Advanced tab: API Base, Provider, Costs, Extra Params. NEW file.
REWRITE as thin composer exposing ModelConfigController.
REWRITE as Tabs shell + sticky footer; consumes ModelConfigController.
Minimal update to consume the new controller shape; verify typecheck/test/lint.

requirementsChecklist.title: Tab-based UI shell (General / Routing / Advanced)
acceptanceCriteria: Settings tab renders shadcn Tabs with three triggers: General, Routing, Advanced
General tab opens by default
Each tab hosts its dedicated leaf component
Footer is sticky below tab content and shows dirty indicator + Back/Save
notes: General tab content comes from Task-C1, Routing from C2, Advanced from C3

requirementsChecklist.title: Essential fields always visible in General tab
acceptanceCriteria: General tab shows Model Name, Display Name, Family, Owned By, API Mode, Vision, Enabled
Model Name is immutable (disabled, bg-muted)
No hard-coded Portuguese text remains

requirementsChecklist.title: Reasoning section collapsible, collapsed by default
acceptanceCriteria: Reasoning sub-section uses CollapsibleSection with defaultOpen=false
Reasoning Effort, Reasoning API Mode, Enable Thinking, Include Reasoning switches all inside
Collapsing the section does not clear values

requirementsChecklist.title: Routing tab isolates aliases editor
acceptanceCriteria: Routing tab renders ModelAliasesEditor
Editor reads aliases from dedicated aliases query hook, not from form data
Routing tab shows loading and error states

requirementsChecklist.title: Advanced tab shows DB settings
acceptanceCriteria: Advanced tab shows API Base URL, Provider select, Input Cost, Output Cost, Extra Params list
Add Parameter button works
Extra Params remove button works
Empty-key params skipped (existing behavior)

requirementsChecklist.title: useModelConfigForm hook extracted
acceptanceCriteria: ModelConfigFormData type excludes aliasesLoaded/Loading/Error
modelToFormData, buildConfigFromFormData, areFormDataEqual exposed
Hook exposes resetForModel(model) and commitSaved(saved)
isDirty reflects form-only dirty state

requirementsChecklist.title: useModelAliases hook extracted
acceptanceCriteria: Exposes aliases, loaded, loading, error, isDirty, setAliases, resetForModel, getValidationError, normalizedAliases
Aliasing loading state no longer in ModelConfigFormData
validateAliases and normalizeAliases exported as named exports
Toast-once-per-model behavior preserved

requirementsChecklist.title: useModelConfigSave hook extracted
acceptanceCriteria: Receives model, formData, aliases, queryClient, onSaved callback
Calls updateModel then updateModelAliases (when loaded) on save()
All toast messages byte-identical to today
Partial-failure handling preserved (route ok / aliases fail)
Invalidates models-with-config and model-aliases queries on save
Calls onSaved after successful full save so composer clears dirty state

requirementsChecklist.title: useModelConfigPage becomes thin composer
acceptanceCriteria: Composes useModelConfigForm + useModelAliases + useModelConfigSave
Exposes ModelConfigController with combined isDirty = form.isDirty || aliases.isDirty
Re-exports ModelConfigFormData from use-model-config-form for existing importers
Settings tab wired via Task-D3-0007

requirementsChecklist.title: Dirty state preserved across tab switches
acceptanceCriteria: Switching tabs does not reset form values
Switching tabs does not clear edited aliases
Footer shows combined dirty state (form || aliases) at all times
notes: Achieved naturally because tab content shares one state source

requirementsChecklist.title: Model context change resets form + aliases
acceptanceCriteria: When the ModelDetailContext provides a new model, form.resetForModel(model) is called
When modelName changes, aliases.resetForModel(modelName) is triggered
Previous unsaved edits are discarded on context change
